title: ColabFold-supported binding tests identify CDKL5 interactions with synaptic scaffolds
summary: A preprint first posted 28 August 2025 used ColabFold/AlphaFold modeling to support a proposed interaction between the neuronal CDKL5 isoform and a SHANK1 PDZ domain. Fluorescence-polarization and NMR experiments supported direct binding, while disrupting the terminal binding motif abolished it; the preprint reported an affinity of 8.5 micromolar. The November 2026 journal version reports 7.6 micromolar for the same interaction and further cellular/neuronal context. These are versions of one result. AI supported a structural interaction hypothesis; binding assays provide the direct evidence. The distinct talin-binding result is not attributed to AI here, and the work does not establish clinical effects or treatment for CDKL5 deficiency disorder.
ai_technology: ColabFold/AlphaFold protein-complex modeling of the CDKL5 C-terminal peptide and SHANK1 PDZ domain
organization: University of Liverpool; University of Helsinki

evidence.tested: ColabFold-supported PDZ-binding hypothesis tested by fluorescence polarization, NMR and disruption of the terminal binding motif, with tests of other synaptic PDZ domains. The 2025 v1 reported SHANK1 affinity 8.5 micromolar; the 2026 journal version reports 7.6 micromolar. Both support the same specific direct-binding finding.
evidence.unknown: No atomic-resolution experimental structure of the predicted complex or patient-derived/in vivo disease validation is reported. Neuronal localization and spine effects use transfected/overexpression systems and do not establish treatment or clinical outcomes. The paper also reports talin binding; that result is not attributed to AlphaFold here.
evidence.ai_role: ColabFold generated a complex model supporting a sequence/motif-based CDKL5–SHANK1 interaction hypothesis, which was tested with binding and perturbation assays. AI is not credited with the separate talin finding or clinical effects.

source_review.scope: Author-institutional bioRxivv1PDF header and relevant ColabFold/binding Results independently extracted/read; final primary article abstract and relevant Results, model-use reference and metadata independently read. Numerical versions distinguished; no clinical reanalysis.

follow_up.note: Peer-reviewed journal version of the same PDZ-binding result. The final article reports SHANK1 affinity 7.6 micromolar, versus 8.5 micromolar in preprint v1; this numerical revision is preserved rather than backdated.
